{{Quote|Forget the disturbance in the Force for a while and get something to eat. We have heavy work ahead of us when we reach Yarille.|[[Geith Eris]], part of the [[Altisian Jedi]]'s relief effort to Yarille following the battle there|<ref name="The Clone Wars: No Prisoners">''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]''</ref>}}
A '''battle''' took place on [[Yarille]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The fighting was brief and soon moved on. The [[Altisian Jedi]] sect later conducted a relief effort in Yarille's regional [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Yen Bachask]].
